policyDefinitions.target: A contiguous textual label organizing substantive document content or outline.
policyDefinitions.boundary: complete contiguous label, meaningful numbering/punctuation included, surrounding whitespace excluded, source-local UTF-16 half-open offsets
ambiguous: The human hierarchy guideline says title/running-header/TOC/appendix/table-only text are context but does not itself redefine heading labels.
Legal marker inclusion is evidenced by the reviewed legal reference, not a global regex rule.
Per-document approved projections remain instance evidence and are not copied into the runtime prompt.
